_comment: OPTIONAL authed usage readers, per surface. Map a surface -> a shell command that prints exactly ONE integer 0-100 = percent headroom remaining. The fleet runs it and uses the result as that surface's headroom, overriding quota-axi / the blind default. Use it for surfaces whose usage is not observable via quota-axi. The command OWNS all secret handling (read the token from a 0600 file; never put it on argv). Copy this to config/quota-overrides.json (gitignored) and fill in. Empty string or missing key = blind / fail-open (the default). Copilot and Cursor ship working readers: set "copilot": "<repo>/bin/quota-copilot-usage.sh" and "cursor": "<repo>/bin/quota-cursor-usage.sh".
